nodes.label: Step 15: analyze_intelligence.py
nodes.description: Eight fresh lineages, frozen founder/evolved archives, unseen standard/wide arenas, food-hidden/mirrored conditions and counterfactual steering probes; plot_intelligence.py. Three of four operational criteria pass; robust generalization remains unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Step 21: experiment_seasons.py
nodes.description: Eight fresh seasonal lineages with maturity gates and matched frozen archive/founder diagnostics; plot_seasons.py. Four lineages fail in winter; improved inherited controller performance can coexist with actual lineage extinction; descriptive analyses.

nodes.label: Step 24: experiment_predator_prey.py
nodes.description: Eight fresh two-gene-pool lineages freeze generations one, four and eight for nine historical opponent pairings and two opponent-sensor masks; plot_predator_prey.py. Reciprocal improvement is not established; no frozen-opponent or drift training control.

nodes.label: Step 25: experiment_social.py
nodes.description: Eight source seeds pair individual/group selection and frozen sharing/signal interventions under restricted/open food access; plot_social.py. Founder-adjusted sharing tests do not establish evolved beneficial cooperation; group selection also changes team assortment.

nodes.label: Step 26: experiment_ecosystem.py
nodes.description: Eight source seeds run abundant/scarce by mutating/clonal conditions for six hundred seconds; plot_ecosystem.py. Abundant arms show finite-window founder replacement/renewal; scarce arms go extinct; descriptive results do not isolate selection from drift or prove indefinite persistence.

nodes.label: Step 13: compare_creatures.py
nodes.description: Eight-seed pilot compares evolved, random motor and fresh-unselected-neural conditions; final frozen cohorts use matched held-out arenas. plot_comparison.py exports outcomes; no established evolved advantage over random.

nodes.label: Step 19: experiment_specialization.py
nodes.description: Eighteen new matched seed groups train three habitat specialists and a counterbalanced domain-cycling generalist; freezes unscored generation-ten offspring after nine reproductions; plot_specialization.py. Reciprocal specialization and home superiority over generalists are not established.

nodes.label: Sensor and neuron interventions
nodes.description: Food hidden/mirrored inputs, obstacle-risk masks, opponent-input masks, received-signal masks, local Jacobians and hidden-unit ablations examine input-dependent control.
nodes.rationale: Masks may create distribution shifts; immediate command effects differ from whole-run fitness effects, and sensor dependence does not identify a unique learned algorithm.

nodes.label: Step 14: experiment_parameters.py
nodes.description: Four-seed seven-setting one-factor-at-a-time mutation/population/food sweep; plot_parameters.py shows paired frozen-validation gaps. Exploratory pointwise intervals, no confirmed winner or global optimum.

nodes.label: Random movement controller
nodes.description: Ignores food and inherited brain arrays; holds random turn rates for approximately 0.75–2 seconds and cruises at the prescribed speed.

nodes.label: reproduction.py and selection.py
nodes.description: Immutable fitness ranking, rounded-up top-20-percent selection, balanced shuffled offspring and independent asexual genome copies with parameterwise Gaussian mutation; no crossover or gradient training.

nodes.label: Fitness-dependent parent selection
nodes.description: Ordinary fitness is survival seconds plus ten times consumed pellets; completed lifetimes, including early deaths, remain selectable; top twenty of one hundred parents supply five offspring each.
nodes.rationale: Meal rewards count partly wasted food and do not directly measure energetic efficiency or intelligence.

nodes.label: Food seeking world
nodes.description: Ordinary model has nearest-food/hunger/wall inputs, reflective walls, replenished food and survival-plus-meals fitness; supports selected/neutral inheritance, random, greedy and frozen founders.

nodes.label: Step 18: experiment_selection.py
nodes.description: ParentPolicyWorld and RecordedMutationRNG compare sixteen matched selected/neutral seed pairs over ten scored generations and nine inheritance transitions. plot_selection.py; supported net selection improvement in uniform and wide-clustered tests, inconclusive neutral comparison in standard clusters.

nodes.label: Ancestry and genetic diversity
nodes.description: Records parent edges, founder families, ancestry depth, unique genotype hashes and standardized genetic RMS; continuous worlds also report within-family variation and threshold-dependent connected components.

nodes.label: Scientific scope and limitations
nodes.description: Results apply to specific stylized two-dimensional models, finite budgets and declared environments. Generational cohort death differs from lineage extinction or failed continuous renewal; distinct worlds have different objectives and are not pooled.
nodes.rationale: Behavioral gains, genome distance, founder families and genetic clusters do not establish planning, general intelligence, species, reciprocal cooperation or indefinite ecosystem sustainability.

nodes.label: Step 20: inspect_brains.py
nodes.description: Reuses Step 16 evolved and Step 17 founder cohorts; passive whole-population observations, preselected individual traces, exact Jacobians, hidden-unit ablations and common probe grid. plot_brains.py emits overview and self-contained brain_viewer.html playback; descriptive only.

nodes.label: Step 17: experiment_strategy.py
nodes.description: Reuses all Step 16 evolved cohorts and reconstructed founders without retraining; food mirroring/hiding and founder-adjusted bearing tests support useful food guidance. plot_strategy.py; residual hidden-input advantage remains inconclusive.

nodes.label: Step 27: experiment_evaluation.py
nodes.description: Reuses all sixteen Step 18 paired populations for fresh five-environment matched evolved/random/greedy/neutral/founder and food-hidden testing; evaluation_world.py accelerates broad phase while retaining scalar contact rules; plot_evaluation.py and audit_evaluation.py. Evolved food adaptation is supported but greedy wins, clustered neutral contrasts remain inconclusive, scarcity is severe and barren worlds starve.

nodes.label: Step 16: experiment_speed.py
nodes.description: Sixteen newly trained fixed-speed lineages benchmark evolved/random/greedy on uniform, clustered and wide-clustered tests; plot_speed.py. Evolved beats random in clustered worlds; uniform result is inconclusive and greedy is stronger.

nodes.label: Neutral random-parent inheritance
nodes.description: Step 18 samples twenty parents uniformly without replacement from all one hundred completed lifetimes; matched bottleneck, mutation masks/noise and shuffled birth slots isolate parent choice.
nodes.rationale: Eligibility includes early deaths to prevent survival selection entering the neutral control; distinct from random movement and fresh-brain replacement.

nodes.label: Independent-seed paired inference
nodes.description: Training seed or paired source seed is the independent unit; repeats average within seed. Confirmatory studies use exact two-sided paired sign tests, 1e-10 ties, familywise Holm correction and twenty-thousand seed-paired percentile bootstrap resamples.
nodes.rationale: Directional decisions require adjusted p below 0.05 and a same-direction interval excluding zero; intervals are approximate pointwise, and inconclusive results do not establish equivalence.

nodes.label: Greedy controller
nodes.description: Turns toward nearest sensed food with the same turn limit/range and random fallback; fixed-speed comparisons use sixty pixels per second and five energy units per living second.

nodes.label: Step 23: experiment_traits.py
nodes.description: Twelve fresh joint brain/body lineages with frozen joint, brain-only, body-only and founder combinations; plot_traits.py. Standard-food improvement over founders passes; distinct evolved-body benefit and scarcity advantage remain unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Step 22: experiment_obstacles.py
nodes.description: Twelve fresh obstacle-world lineages test frozen evolved/intact, risk-hidden and original sixteen-input founders on matched held-out layouts; plot_obstacles.py. Foraging improves, while joint avoidance criterion and added-risk sensor benefit are unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Brains and bodies world
nodes.description: body_traits.py links neural inheritance to speed, radius and sensory range; separate neural/body mutation streams and explicit development, storage, maintenance, locomotion and sensing costs.

nodes.label: NeuralNetwork
nodes.description: brain.py provides independent NumPy tanh feed-forward networks, inference and mutated_copy; ordinary controllers have 8 inputs, 8 hidden units, 2 outputs and 90 parameters; no lifetime learning or recurrent memory.

nodes.label: Continuous ecosystem world
nodes.description: ecosystem.py uses overlapping lifetimes, energy-funded parent-paid births, finite regrowth, population cap and absorbing extinction; no synchronized cohort selection or automatic immigration/rescue.

nodes.label: Obstacles and hazards world
nodes.description: obstacles.py adds barriers, energy-draining regions, 16–8–2 brains, radius-aware swept collision and explicit collision/hazard fitness penalties; risk inputs can be masked.

nodes.label: Predator and prey world
nodes.description: predator_prey.py uses simultaneous opponent snapshots, swept capture ownership, 11–8–2 brains and separate prey/predator selection pools with distinct meal/capture objectives.

nodes.label: Changing seasons world
nodes.description: seasons.py varies food stock by generation, moves four seeded clusters, and requires reproductive maturity; no eligible parent causes absorbing lineage extinction.

nodes.label: Social behavior world
nodes.description: social.py uses isolated groups, 17–8–3 brains, local neighbors, costly signals and lossy stored-energy sharing; individual/group policies select using actual survival age.

nodes.label: World and EvolutionSimulation
nodes.description: world.py implements one-generation physics, sensing, food, survival and fitness; simulation.py handles timing, automatic cohorts, limits and reports; main.py retains the original viewer.

nodes.label: Research records and export bundles
nodes.description: Numeric model/trace/genome archives use allow_pickle=False and integrity checks; complete studies retain all outcomes and protect existing paths. Unified exports include config/tick history, lifetime/telemetry/lineage CSVs, numeric genomes, plots, screenshot, HTML report and SHA-256 manifest.

nodes.label: Declared protocols and preservation audits
nodes.description: Protocols record budgets, source/model hashes and excluded layouts before production trials; baseline manifests preserve earlier artifacts, and audits reconstruct starts, mutations, energy ledgers, raw records and inference.
nodes.rationale: Declarations are local rather than external preregistrations; replayed deterministic seeds verify reproducibility without adding independent evidence.

nodes.label: Automated checks and deterministic replay
nodes.description: README records 428 passing checks and seven-mode export/bitwise replay validation. CI uses Python 3.13.17 and pinned dependencies on Linux/macOS; bounded engineering smoke checks remain separate from full scientific studies.

nodes.label: Artificial Evolution 1.0.1
nodes.description: Step 28 research workbench investigates food-seeking evolution in tiny neural controllers and integrates seven worlds and fifteen studies.

nodes.label: Immutable run export bundle
nodes.description: A background worker receives an immutable snapshot and writes a fresh exports subfolder: config/run JSON, population/individual/telemetry/lineage/generation CSVs, numeric genomes.npz, scientific PNG/SVG/PDF figures, optional GUI screenshot, relative-link report.html and SHA-256 manifest.json. Load genomes with allow_pickle=False.

nodes.label: Steps 13–27 research catalog
nodes.description: All 15 studies expose published figures, isolated full-protocol jobs, progress, cancellation and plotting.

nodes.label: Validated configuration transitions
nodes.description: Apply/new run constructs and validates before replacing the current run, then archives the previous run asynchronously. Invalid settings preserve the active simulation. Import loads presets/config.json. Clonal reproduction zeros mutation, social studies fix body traits, and population/group divisibility is validated.

nodes.label: Version 1.0.1 packaging repair
nodes.description: Both ZIPs include identical committed MIT LICENSE bytes and license SHA-256 entries. Source ZIP adds .python-version, .gitattributes and GitHub Actions workflow. Archives are rebuilt from the tagged commit with BUILD-INFO.json and SHA256SUMS.txt.
nodes.rationale: The missing runtime-version file made the v1.0.0 ZIP provenance validator fail; original v1.0.0 tag and assets are preserved.

nodes.label: Python 3.13 installation and launch
nodes.description: Create and activate .venv with python3.13, install requirements.txt and launch python simulator.py. Prepared checkouts activate the environment and launch. Original main.py and earlier experiment interfaces keep their published commands and sources.

nodes.label: Creature and hazard observation
nodes.description: Creature inspector shows parent/root family, energy, inherited dimensions and eight current-state hidden activations. Hazard overlap costs 12 energy and 5 fitness per second; rings, exposure counts and energy bars show exposure, while inspection provides accumulated losses and time. Eating can replenish energy during exposure.

nodes.label: Seven simulation worlds
nodes.description: Food seeking, seasons, obstacles/hazards, inherited brains/bodies, predator–prey, social behavior and continuous ecosystems use mode-appropriate controllers, selection and reproduction mechanisms.

nodes.label: World-specific algorithms and environments
nodes.description: Food worlds provide fitness/neutral/random/greedy/frozen founders; seasons use maturity eligibility; hazards offer fitness/random/greedy; brains/bodies jointly select neural/body traits; predator/prey selects two gene pools; social selects group/individual survival; continuous ecosystem uses funded/clonal reproduction.

nodes.label: Frozen, random and greedy controller baselines
nodes.description: Frozen founders replay original controllers in fresh cohorts. Random and greedy controllers carry unused placeholder neural arrays excluded from live neural diversity.
nodes.norm_label: frozen, random and greedy controller baselines

nodes.label: Mode-dependent measurement and censoring
nodes.description: Generational means include current live/dead cohort actors and reset at cohort boundaries; continuous earned fitness averages recorded lifetimes and also exports living-only fitness. Predator/prey scores remain separate; social fitness is survival age. Biological death, cohort retirement and right censoring are distinct. Generational replacement counts are not continuous demographic births.

nodes.label: Three distinct kinds of evidence
nodes.description: Interactive demonstration is one seeded run with provisional metrics; engineering integration checks exercise software behavior without estimating treatment effects; independent-seed research studies support statistical conclusions within their protocols and limitations.

nodes.label: Genealogical lineage records
nodes.description: Lineage display includes every observed birth/parent edge and extinct branches. Generational actors use generation plus creature ID; continuous actors have globally unique birth IDs. Founder families are genealogical labels, not inferred species.

nodes.label: Recorded-run reproduction
nodes.description: Load config.json for fresh parameters; verify a bundle and replay run.json for the recorded history. Semantic controls are logged at physics ticks. Environment/algorithm changes archive separate runs. Observation/export do not consume model randomness; continuous endpoint sampling is isolated.

nodes.label: Neutral inheritance control
nodes.description: Parents are sampled uniformly from every completed lifetime, including early deaths, while retaining the selection arm's mutation and parent bottleneck.

nodes.label: Author-run public-download verification
nodes.description: RELEASE-VERIFICATION.json records fresh-environment testing of public downloads: checksums, license/manifests, dependencies, launch, export/replay and engineering validation. It is author-run verification, not independent scientific review or new training evidence.

nodes.label: Neural RMS interpretation
nodes.description: Raw per-parameter pair-distance summary of living neural controllers excludes body genes. It measures neither functional intelligence nor a standardized quantity across brain architectures.

nodes.label: Observational hazard feedback
nodes.description: Red zones display extra 12 energy/second cost and exposure count. Zone inspection, warning rings, red energy bars and creature damage/exposure details reveal existing hazard damage; numerical physics are unchanged.

nodes.label: Recorded validated runtime
nodes.description: Release checked on macOS using Python 3.13.17, NumPy 2.5.4, Pygame 2.6.1 and Matplotlib 3.11.2, with pinned direct/transitive requirements, native interactions and SDL dummy-display checks. Source hashes identify each export implementation.

nodes.label: Verified tick-and-control replay
nodes.description: Replay reconstructs configuration, each physics tick and semantic controls, then compares metrics, lifetimes, canonical report and available telemetry. Numeric archive preserves birth genomes. GUI replay opens verified state paused; remaining budget can continue. Keep bundles together for links and hash checks.

nodes.label: Reproducing published study protocols
nodes.description: Research catalog delegates to original scripts in fresh output folders, retaining commands, working directory, hashes, logs, canonical protocols/results and plots. Saved-population studies require research evidence. Scores across model modes must not be pooled because fitness measures address different questions.

nodes.label: Full-protocol research job lifecycle
nodes.description: Research launches original scripts with full seed/training budgets and selectable workers, unaffected by live settings. job.json, exact command, source hashes, progress, data and figure are retained. Script and plotter must both succeed. Cancellation stops the owned process group and preserves partial records; app closure cancels jobs and waits for exports.

nodes.label: Source and research release assets
nodes.description: Source asset contains application, presets, guides, demonstration figures and Step 27 summary/figures. Optional research asset adds historical datasets, trained populations and raw histories. Extract both under shared Artificial_Evolution-v1.0.1/ prefix; Steps 17, 20 and 27 need trained inputs. Check downloads with shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt.

nodes.label: Interactive simulation controls
nodes.description: Space pauses; S requests 1x/5x/20x speed; A toggles breeding/births; N advances finished generational cohorts; R restarts and archives; E exports; L opens ancestry; B opens Research; H opens help. Text editing takes precedence over shortcuts.

nodes.label: Step 27 analysis units and correction
nodes.description: Step 27 reused all 16 Step 18 training pairs in new matched worlds. Its 1,056 cohorts are not independent training replicates. Test repeats are averaged within training seed; Holm correction treats 45 primary and 21 exploratory tests separately.
nodes.rationale: Training seed is the inferential unit; protocol and failure cases constrain interpretations of improvement over random or neutral control.

nodes.label: Fixed physics ticks and playback speed
nodes.description: Target speed is a playback request; measured speed is simulated seconds per wall-clock second. Bounded rendering workload keeps controls responsive while every physics step stays 1/60 second, without skipping movement or survival ticks.
nodes.norm_label: fixed physics ticks and playback speed

nodes.label: Controlled scientific record
nodes.description: The latest evaluation used 16 archived training pairs and fresh matched environments. Gains over random movement coexist with a large greedy-controller gap, environment-dependent neutral comparisons and severe scarcity failures. Live demonstrations are descriptive; independent-seed studies support inference.

nodes.label: Artificial Evolution research workbench
nodes.description: Unified Python/Pygame application for Steps 1–28, with live curves, ancestry, inspection, configuration validation, automatic archiving, background exports and verified replay.

nodes.label: Deterministic Git-based release builder
nodes.description: build_release.py reads committed blobs from the release tag, fixes ZIP timestamps/permissions, emits source/research ZIPs with separate file manifests, SHA-256 checksums and exact-commit BUILD-INFO.json. A repeat-build test checks identical archive hashes.
nodes.rationale: Committed Git blobs exclude untracked files and working-tree changes from release packages; upload digests are checked separately.

nodes.label: Historical source and artifact preservation
nodes.description: step28-baseline.json records the preceding commit and 427 tracked hashes; final audit checks all 426 earlier files except README. Model kernels and 347 earlier research-result artifacts retain original versions; early native records retain fields and checksums.

nodes.label: Seven-mode engineering integration validation
nodes.description: unittest discovery and validate_simulator.py verify seven modes, file/genome manifests, replays and saved native interactions. A two-seed, one-second ecosystem job exercises the real study launcher and plotter; full Step 26 uses its separate 600-second protocol.

nodes.label: Requested-step project workflow
nodes.description: Implement only the currently requested experiment step; check it, commit and push master to https://github.com/Maitham16/Artificial_Evolution.git. Exclude virtual environments, caches, bytecode and OS files. If .git writes are blocked, perform Git operations in a permitted temporary checkout and copy only intended project files.

nodes.label: Matched frozen held-out evaluation
nodes.description: Tests complete birth cohorts, including poor performers and early deaths, on fresh namespace-separated layouts with matched initial physical conditions; no test retraining, mutation or champion filtering.
nodes.rationale: Later replenished food can diverge with behavior; control applies to initial conditions and replenishment rules, not identical future coordinates.
